items.description: A bold coffee cake with layers of rich salted caramel, caramelised almonds and a buttery cookie crumble. Each bite offers a delightful crunch alongside the moist, espresso-infused cake. This decadent treat is perfect for coffee lovers looking for a sweet twist on a classic cake.
